title: ProducedRuns
description: The runs a worker has produced, returned by GET /runs: every run record written to its output directory, newest first by finish time. Each carries a null review — a worker keeps no review store, so a run gains a review only when it is published.

id.description: The run record's id (its output-directory name).

record.description: The produced run record, exactly as the run wrote it.

review.description: Always null: a produced-but-unpublished run carries no review yet.
